name: kr-ui-kit-svg-consolidation
description: Consolidate KR-UI SVG assets, fix token map, fix CSS generator

steps.name: preflight
steps.description: Verify clean working tree on kerala-rage-branch, locate required scripts and files

steps.name: mkdir-svg-subdirs
steps.description: Create motifs/, icons/, patterns/ subdirectories for KR-UI-008..019

steps.name: verify-svg-color-vars
steps.description: Confirm all existing SVGs use --kr-* vars (no --color-* found). Skip batch rename.

steps.name: create-placeholder-svgs
steps.description: Generate contract-valid placeholder SVGs for KR-UI-008..019 in canonical paths

steps.name: fix-token-map
steps.description: Update kr-solidarity-ui-token-map.json: promote KR-UI-008..019 from ui_kit_gaps to tokens section, fix null-path aliases, update status for 001-007 in ui_kit_gaps
mutations: Move KR-UI-008..019 entries into tokens section with canonical paths
Set alias entries (field-grid, field-layout, ink-slam-mark) path to their canonical target SVG paths
Update ui_kit_gaps 001-007 status from planned to ready

steps.name: fix-css-token-generator
steps.description: Fix build-design-tokens.py to flatten nested color dicts instead of serializing Python repr. Also update output path to match build-m3-tokens.py or consolidate.
steps.mutation: Replace line 43 color serialization with recursive flattening that emits one CSS var per leaf value
steps.root_cause: Line 43: f'--sys-color-{key}: {value}' where value is a nested dict -> Python repr {'DEFAULT': ...} written as CSS value
steps.fix: Flatten nested color dicts: if isinstance(value, dict), iterate and emit --sys-color-{key}-{subkey}: {subvalue} for each leaf

steps.name: validate
steps.description: Run validation checks: no TODO[asset] in hifi docs, SVGs only use --kr-*, CSS contains no {'DEFAULT':
commands: grep -r "{'DEFAULT':" frontend/src/styles/design-tokens.css && echo 'FAIL: dict literals in CSS' || echo 'PASS: no dict literals'
grep -r -- '--color-' frontend/public/assets/kr-solidarity/ui-kit/svg/ && echo 'FAIL: --color-* in SVGs' || echo 'PASS: SVGs clean'
grep -c 'TODO\[asset\]\|TODO\[svg\]\|TODO\[token\]' docs/design/generated/*.md && echo 'WARN: TODOs remain' || echo 'PASS: no TODOs'

steps.name: fast-checks
steps.description: Run minimal lint and type checks

steps.name: commit-and-report
steps.description: Stage changes, commit with conventional message, write summary report
commands: git commit -m 'fix(design): consolidate KR-UI SVG assets, fix CSS dict serialization bug, populate 008-019 placeholders'

codex_prompts: A: Verify git status is clean and all required scripts and token files exist at expected paths.
B: Create directories frontend/public/assets/kr-solidarity/ui-kit/svg/motifs/, icons/, and patterns/ if they do not exist.
C: Grep all SVG files under frontend/public/assets/kr-solidarity/ui-kit/svg/ for --color-* and confirm zero matches.

D: Write a Node script scripts/kr/generate-placeholder-svgs.mjs that creates 12 contract-valid placeholder SVGs (KR-UI-008 through KR-UI-019) at their canonical_svg_path locations from kr-solidarity-ui-token-map.json ui_kit_gaps, each with viewBox 0 0 512 512, title, desc, g#base/content/accent groups, using only var(--kr-surface|text|primary|secondary|tertiary) colors, stroke-width 2|3|4|6 round caps, no text/filter/mask/pattern/image/foreignObject. Run it.

E: Write a Node script scripts/kr/fix-token-map.mjs that reads kr-solidarity-ui-token-map.json, promotes KR-UI-008..019 from ui_kit_gaps into the tokens section with fields id/name/kind/render_mode/canonical_svg_path/opacity_default/scale_safe/status set to ready, resolves the three null-path alias entries to point at their canonical target SVG paths, updates ui_kit_gaps 001-007 status to ready, bumps version to 1.1.0, and writes the file back. Run it.

F: Fix scripts/build-design-tokens.py line 43 so that when a color value is a nested dict it flattens into individual CSS vars (--sys-color-{key}-{subkey}: {subvalue}) instead of serializing the Python dict repr. Regenerate frontend/src/styles/design-tokens.css and verify zero occurrences of {'DEFAULT'.

G: Validate: grep frontend/src/styles/design-tokens.css for {'DEFAULT' (expect 0), grep SVGs for --color-* (expect 0), grep docs/design/generated/*.md for TODO[asset] markers, and parse the token map JSON to confirm validity.
H: Run npx tsc --noEmit in frontend/, then run both python3 scripts/build-m3-tokens.py and python3 scripts/build-design-tokens.py to verify clean generation.

I: Stage all changed files under frontend/public/assets/kr-solidarity/, scripts/kr/, and scripts/build-design-tokens.py, then commit with message 'fix(design): consolidate KR-UI SVG assets, fix CSS dict serialization bug, populate 008-019 placeholders'.
